d: Gallery in the Palazzo d'Argirio. Knights scattered throughout the scene, others who arrive introduced by Scudieri, who then remain at the doors. Isaura, and various Damigelle seco: two Scudieri carry two silver basins, on which many white scarves; the Knights embrace, untie their scarves, some bleu, others red, which distinguished the various parties, sung in part choir.

Delicious park in the Palazzo d'Argirio, of which you can see a magnificent part: in the prospect a flowery beach of a bosom of sea, which lambe the walls of the palace. Vials, statues, gates etc.. Land a squeak: Roggiero goes down, exploring, and then Tancredi, four Scudieri carry the signs of Tancredi, the spear, the shield, on which you see written the words "FEDE" , "ONORE" .

Great square of Syracuse. Rich people. Arranged nobles. March: Soldiers, Shields, Knights who precede the triumphal chariot on which appearsTancredi. The armor of Orbazzano is a trophy. Tancredi's squires bring to the sides of the chariot of himsigns. I rode with the shield.

Chain of mountains, steep ravines, streams that fall and go to form the Aretusa; forest that covers part of the plane and of the mountain; Etna in the distance; the sun towards the west, and reverberates on the sea, on the opposite side. African curtains scattered over the mountains. Some caves. During the refrain you see Tancredi climbing, going down, concentrated gloomy progresses sighing, he stops.
Argirio, and Amenaìde, followed by Knights and Soldiers.
